register.labelZh: FLOOD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: flood back 可以描述回憶、想法或恐懼突然再次湧現。；flood in 和 flood into 可以描述人群、水、訊息、電話和訂單大量湧來。；flood over 和 flood through 可以表示某種強烈感受突然湧上心頭或湧遍全身。；flood out 可以解釋人們為何因水浸而要離開建築物;flood something with something 則可以描述收到大量電話、訊息或要求。
register.summaryEn: Flood back helps you describe memories, thoughts or fears that suddenly return. Flood in and flood into can describe crowds, water, messages, calls and orders arriving in large numbers. Flood over and flood through show that a strong feeling suddenly fills someone. Flood out explains why people must leave a building because of water. Flood something with something describes receiving too many calls, messages or requests.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；在指定地點前使用 flood into;若後面沒有直接接上地點,則可使用 flood in。；flood somebody out 經常以 be flooded out 的形式出現。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Use flood into before a named place. Use flood in when no place follows it directly. People flooded into the hall. Messages flooded in. Flood somebody out often appears as be flooded out. We were flooded out by the storm.
